svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 CoAP: server, identity, uplink, Observe and RPC

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 CoAP: server, identity, uplink, Observe and RPC
UDP 5683 is always configured when CoAP is enabled.
DTLS 5684 is optional. Resource children are dynamic path segments.
Plain token or DTLS identity resolution
[request has DTLS session id and peer state]
Created acknowledges Queue production, not Rule Engine execution or DB commit.
